home.hero_subtitle: Access verified exam solutions, collaborate with instructors, and excel in your studies with our comprehensive question archive.
home.feature_1_description: Write and render complex mathematical formulas with precision using our integrated MathJax editor.
home.feature_2_description: All solutions are provided and verified by experienced instructors to ensure accuracy.

home.cta_subtitle: Become a verified contributor and share your expertise with students across the university.
home.faq_1_question: How do I become a verified instructor?
home.faq_1_answer: Submit a role request through the Support Center with your academic credentials. Our admin team will review your application and verify your instructor status.
home.faq_2_question: How can I write mathematical formulas?
home.faq_2_answer: Our platform supports MathJax syntax. Simply use LaTeX notation within your answers, such as $E = mc^2$ for inline formulas or $$...$$ for displayed equations.
home.faq_3_answer: Yes! Verified instructors can attach PDF files and images to their answers, providing detailed step-by-step solutions.
home.faq_4_question: What if I find an error in an answer?
home.faq_4_answer: Use the Content Report feature on any question or answer to notify our team. We take accuracy seriously and will review reported content promptly.

footer.description: The premier platform for collaborative learning and exam preparation at KNTU.

reports.title: Report Content
reports.description: To report a specific question or answer for content errors, please navigate to that item and click the Report icon. For general issues, please use the Support Center.
reports.how_to_report_step_1: Navigate to the question or answer you want to report.
reports.how_to_report_step_2: Click on the Report icon (flag symbol) next to the content.
reports.how_to_report_step_3: Fill out the report form with details about the issue.
